flags.message: gemini-baseline describes a September 29/October 19 distribution sequence, October 15 rescheduling and an October 30 conference, whereas the staged docket records July 22/October 28 distributions for September 28/November 13 with an August 14 response request. It also states initial registration in 1982 and Georgia cert denial March 3; the petition says 1985 and March 31. Its claimed 5–4 Georgia denial is unsubstantiated in the staged text. These discrepancies affect the rationale and forecast grades. All gemini-baseline retrieval results are outcome_only, and its original snapshot is not staged, so the origin of the conflicting account cannot be determined. No outcome leakage is inferred.
